Upload your design, share your requirements, and receive a custom quotation from our team. Get reliable parts, personalized support, and practical manufacturing solutions to help you bring your ideas to life.
content.quoteTitle: Bring Your Design to Life,  Request a Quote
content.quoteText: Upload your STEP file, let our team review your requirements, and request a tailored quote for your project. Get the right manufacturing solution for your design, backed by engineering-focused support. Your file stays on your device until you choose to submit it for review.

steps.title: Upload your STEP file
steps.desc: Get an instant estimate in your browser. Your file is not uploaded anywhere until you send an inquiry.

steps.title: Send an inquiry
steps.desc: Confirm material, quantity and deadline. We review the model and reply within a few hours.

steps.title: We print
steps.desc: Your parts are sliced, printed and quality-checked on calibrated machines.

steps.title: Delivery or pickup
steps.desc: Pick up in Vadodara or get it shipped across India.

content.aboutTitle: A small workshop that answers its phone
content.aboutText:
The Aero Forge 3D started in Vadodara, Gujarat in 2026. We are engineers, so we look at your design before we print it and tell you honestly if a small change will make it stronger, faster or cheaper to make.

Founders, students, workshops and factories send us their parts. You deal directly with the person running the printers, not a ticket queue.

faqs.q: Which file formats can I send?
faqs.a: STEP or STP for the instant quote. In an inquiry you can also attach STL, 3MF, OBJ, PDF or ZIP up to 15 MB.

content.contactTitle: Tell us what you need printed
content.contactText: Send a message with your file or idea. We reply within a few hours during working hours.
content.leadText: Choose your country and currency, then enter your details to see your instant estimate. We only use them to follow up on your quote.
content.unitLabel: What unit is your model in?
content.drawHint: Add drawings or reference files (max 5 MB each, up to 5 files) and any notes.
